text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaaarvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"And now, the second half of the circus 
begins! You're not satisfied yet, right? 
You wanna be blown away even more, 
right?!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Show me your smiles! Let me hear your 
cheers! Come on, let's go find an even 
bigger Marvelous!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Holy crap! This circus is way too fun! 
The Holy Hoof Festival is the best! The 
Umamusume are incredible! I'm totally a 
fan now!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"I'm baaack☆ Ahaha. It's so dark in here! 
The circus tent dressing room is so 
Marvelous★"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome back. We finished the first half 
of the program 2 minutes and 16 seconds 
ahead of schedule. However, the real test 
begins now. Stay focused."

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Yep, you got it! From here on out, it's 
big props kaboom! Flashy stunts bang-bang! 
The thrill is so Marvelous☆"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. That is precisely why it is 
impossible to predict what kind of 
accidents may occur. While always 
maintaining a certain buffer—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Trouble, big trouble! The motorcycle 
broke down! You know, the one for riding 
around inside the steel globe cage!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. Please lead the way."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I checked with the repair technician, and 
it will take 2 hours to get here, plus 
another hour for repairs... So—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Let us use the next 3 minutes and 43 
seconds to discuss whether we can adapt 
this act into another format. If anyone 
has ideas—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume D
text_block_list.text:
"Right here! Total brainstorm, but what if 
we combine it with another act?! Like 
ball-balancing... wait, is that 
impossible...?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"...T-Then! Instead of ball-balancing, 
what about riding a bicycle inside the 
steel cage? What do you think?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Aha♪ Amazing, amazing! You guys are 
coming up with such wonderful ideas!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe... We're 'chanko buddies' too, 
after all, right? We want to help! As 
members of this circus!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Maaaaarvelouuuus☆★☆ Then, then! Why not 
go all out and—"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Ready? Here we go! One, two, three!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat?! The Umamusume are... running in 
circles inside the cage!!? In the cage 
where people usually ride motorcycles?!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume are crazy fast! I've seen them 
on TV, but—seeing it live is mind-blowing! 
Insaneee!!!"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Maaaaarvelouuuus☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wait, did more of them just join in?!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha! Ahahahaha♪ Yay! This is so fun! 
Ahaha~!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you all for your suggestions. Now 
then, I shall go prepare for the next 
act—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"D-Disaster! Flash-san, the girl on the 
tightrope accidentally wore your costume 
onto the stage just now...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"So, for your next act, Flash-san... 
you'll have to start without your 
costume...!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"............I see. While it is possible 
to make do with a substitute costume, it 
would make it difficult to fully express 
the intended act."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "In a pinch, little pony?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I overheard your predicament. ...Yeah. I 
just came up with one stellar idea. Care 
to hear it?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"In short, the chances of failure aren't 
low. It's a trick where coordination is 
everything, and there's barely any time to 
practice. ...Even so, are you up for it?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Yes. Let's do it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Fully aware of the risks, I have 
determined that it is worth attempting. 
For our target success lies beyond it."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Only by seizing it will everything truly 
be according to schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Phew... Stay calm. 
Angle of the hands, angle of the body... 
everything, just as practiced.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—How utterly beautiful. 
Yet, it's not over just yet.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(After this, follow Fuji-san's directions— 
toi, toi, toi... We can do this, I know we 
can.)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's cast even more magic. 
Three, two, one—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Huh...? What's...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Woah! 
Her outfit is...!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are incredible... This is on a 
whole 
other level for a school festival 
showcase...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(I can see the audience's smiling faces so 
clearly. ...I carried this forward and 
made decisions all for this very moment. 
So achieving results is only natural, 
but... hehe.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Feeling this exhilarated wasn't part of 
the plan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Man, seriously, that was amazing.
